```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(readxl)

source('../../ccMeetTools.R')
boysVarsity <- read_excel('bcc1007.xlsx', sheet='boysVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
girlsVarsity <- read_excel('bcc1007.xlsx', sheet='girlsVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
```

## Competition summary
The weather was nice. Upper 70s and pretty still.

### D.H. Conley Athlete times

```{r}
buildTeamTable(boysVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=13)
buildTeamTable(girlsVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=8)
```

```{r}
scoreMeetSimp(boysVarsity, "BCC Pitt County Teams at Boyd Lee")
```
